```{=html}
<div class="fdm-animation" data-fdm-animation>
  <svg viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-label="Fused deposition modeling animation">
    <rect class="fdm-frame" x="18" y="18" width="364" height="364" rx="8"></rect>
    <g class="fdm-final"></g>
    <g class="fdm-current-support"></g>
    <g class="fdm-current-part"></g>
    <g class="fdm-active"></g>
    <rect class="fdm-plate" x="52" y="344" width="296" height="14" rx="3"></rect>
    <g class="fdm-head">
      <line class="fdm-filament" x1="0" y1="36" x2="0" y2="84"></line>
      <rect class="fdm-carriage" x="-34" y="70" width="68" height="28" rx="5"></rect>
      <path class="fdm-nozzle" d="M -18 98 L 18 98 L 8 123 L -8 123 Z"></path>
      <circle class="fdm-extrusion" cx="0" cy="128" r="4"></circle>
    </g>
  </svg>
</div>
<script>
(() => {
  const roots = document.querySelectorAll("[data-fdm-animation]:not([data-fdm-ready])");
  if (!roots.length) {
    return;
  }

  const svgNamespace = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const layerHeight = 14;
  const layerGap = 2;
  const layerCount = 15;
  const positionsPerLayer = 40;
  const stepMilliseconds = 1000 / positionsPerLayer;
  const visibleLayerHeight = layerHeight - layerGap;
  const bottomY = 344;
  const extrusionCenterY = 128;
  const scanMinX = 76;
  const scanMaxX = 324;
  const materials = {
    part: "#1585da",
    support: "#f08a24",
  };
  const finalMaterials = {
    part: "rgba(21, 133, 218, 0.13)",
    support: "rgba(240, 138, 36, 0.16)",
  };
  const partWidths = [
    [136, 264],
    [136, 264],
    [132, 268],
    [130, 270],
    [128, 272],
    [126, 274],
    [122, 278],
    [118, 282],
    [84, 316],
    [84, 316],
    [96, 304],
    [110, 290],
    [126, 274],
    [144, 256],
    [164, 236],
  ];

  const layers = partWidths.map(([partStart, partEnd], index) => {
    const segments = [];
    if (index < 8) {
      segments.push({ kind: "support", start: 84, end: 114 });
      segments.push({ kind: "support", start: 286, end: 316 });
    }
    segments.push({ kind: "part", start: partStart, end: partEnd });
    return segments.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
  });

  function layerY(index) {
    return bottomY - (index + 1) * layerHeight;
  }

  function makeRect(parent, segment, y, fill, endX = segment.end) {
    const width = Math.max(0, Math.min(segment.end, endX) - segment.start);
    if (width <= 0) {
      return;
    }
    const rect = document.createElementNS(svgNamespace, "rect");
    rect.setAttribute("x", String(segment.start));
    rect.setAttribute("y", String(y));
    rect.setAttribute("width", String(width));
    rect.setAttribute("height", String(visibleLayerHeight));
    rect.setAttribute("rx", "2");
    rect.setAttribute("fill", fill);
    parent.appendChild(rect);
  }

  function materialAt(layer, x) {
    const active = layer.find((segment) => x >= segment.start && x <= segment.end);
    if (active) {
      return active.kind;
    }
    const next = layer.find((segment) => x < segment.start);
    return next ? next.kind : "part";
  }

  function renderStatic(root) {
    const finalGroup = root.querySelector(".fdm-final");
    finalGroup.textContent = "";
    layers.forEach((layer, index) => {
      const y = layerY(index);
      layer.forEach((segment) => {
        makeRect(finalGroup, segment, y, finalMaterials[segment.kind]);
      });
    });
  }

  function renderFrame(root, step) {
    const currentLayer = Math.floor(step / positionsPerLayer) % layerCount;
    const position = step % positionsPerLayer;
    const progress = position / (positionsPerLayer - 1);
    const headX = scanMinX + (scanMaxX - scanMinX) * progress;
    const y = layerY(currentLayer);
    const layer = layers[currentLayer];
    const material = materialAt(layer, headX);
    const groups = {
      part: root.querySelector(".fdm-current-part"),
      support: root.querySelector(".fdm-current-support"),
      active: root.querySelector(".fdm-active"),
    };

    groups.part.textContent = "";
    groups.support.textContent = "";
    groups.active.textContent = "";

    layers.forEach((completeLayer, layerIndex) => {
      if (layerIndex >= currentLayer) {
        return;
      }
      const completeY = layerY(layerIndex);
      completeLayer.forEach((segment) => {
        makeRect(groups[segment.kind], segment, completeY, materials[segment.kind]);
      });
    });

    layer.forEach((segment) => {
      if (headX <= segment.start) {
        return;
      }
      makeRect(groups.active, segment, y, materials[segment.kind], headX);
    });

    const head = root.querySelector(".fdm-head");
    const activeLayerCenterY = y + visibleLayerHeight / 2;
    const headY = activeLayerCenterY - extrusionCenterY;
    head.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${headX.toFixed(2)} ${headY.toFixed(2)})`);
    root.querySelector(".fdm-filament").setAttribute("stroke", materials[material]);
    root.querySelector(".fdm-extrusion").setAttribute("fill", materials[material]);
  }

  roots.forEach((root) => {
    root.dataset.fdmReady = "true";
    renderStatic(root);
    let step = 0;
    renderFrame(root, step);
    window.setInterval(() => {
      step = (step + 1) % (layerCount * positionsPerLayer);
      renderFrame(root, step);
    }, stepMilliseconds);
  });
})();
</script>
```
